reasoning: A hybrid approach combines autonomous reasoning about the biological and statistical relevance of mean smoothness in tumor classification with empirical validation from XAI tools to ensure robustness. autonomous_tasks.expected_output: An assessment of how the loss of mean smoothness might shift the decision boundary or reduce confidence in benign classification.

autonomous_tasks.expected_output: An estimated change in prediction probability for class 1 (benign) and class 0 (malignant).
